answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7632 Country: India Title: I want to ask a question regarding khwab ki tabeer. my father saw a khawab twice that his one of the front teeth was broken(incisor teeth). he pushes it through his tongue and the teeth comes out from his mouth . please tell the tabeer of this khawab , i will be grateful to you. Question: assalamu alaikum, I want to ask a question regarding khwab ki tabeer. my father saw a khawab twice that his one of the front teeth was broken(incisor teeth). he pushes it through his tongue and the teeth comes out from his mouth . please tell the tabeer of this khawab , i will be grateful to you. Answer ID: 7632 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1562/1479=D/1429) There may happen any thing wrong to any of your nearest relative. Pay special attention to doing sadqah (charity) and good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
